member.summary: The children of a node, with the lists among them flattened away.

remarks.para: A node holds its children in numbered slots, and a slot may hold a whole list. This type presents both cases the same way, so a caller sees a flat sequence of nodes and tokens and never a list of its own.

member.summary: The immutable, position-independent half of a syntax tree.

remarks.para: A green node stores its width, never its position, so the same instance can appear at any offset in any number of trees.
